title: DNS: Added limit check to TTL indices used in new statistics
description:
Indexes for arrays which store TTLs for answers, authorities and additionals
were not capped causing overflow. This has now been fixed along with limit
checks in statistical function where arrays are iterated over.

Reference: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/19700

DNS: Added limit check to TTL indices used in new statistics

Indexes for arrays which store TTLs for answers, authorities and additionals
were not capped causing overflow. This has now been fixed along with limit
checks in statistical function where arrays are iterated over.

Reference: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/19700
